name: Clapping Music phase
desc: The faithful reading: two identical 808-clap performers on the 12-pulse cell, the second running .iter(12) so it steps exactly one eighth per cycle and cycles through all twelve phase relationships before returning to unison at cycle 12 — same pulse, pure phase. Peak seeds a %13 rim polymeter and a low tom for weight. Drier and more human than the woodblock .01.

code.sparse: stack(s("cp cp cp ~ cp cp ~ cp ~ cp cp ~").pan(.35).gain(${gain}), s("cp cp cp ~ cp cp ~ cp ~ cp cp ~").iter(12).pan(.65).gain(${gain}*.92)).shape(.12).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.2).slow(24)).room(${room}).mask("<1 1 1 1 1 1 1 0>").fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.full: stack(stack(s("cp cp cp ~ cp cp ~ cp ~ cp cp ~").pan(.32).gain(${gain}), s("cp cp cp ~ cp cp ~ cp ~ cp cp ~").iter(12).pan(.68).gain(${gain}*.92)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.2).slow(24)).shape(.15), s("lt ~ ~ lt ~ ~ lt ~ ~ lt ~ ~").speed(.8).gain(${gain}*.6).lpf(600).shape(.3).pan(.5)).room(${room}).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(stack(s("cp cp cp ~ cp cp ~ cp ~ cp cp ~").pan(.3).gain(${gain}), s("cp cp cp ~ cp cp ~ cp ~ cp cp ~").iter(12).pan(.7).gain(${gain}*.92), s("{rim rim rim ~ rim rim ~ rim ~ rim rim ~}%13").pan(.5).gain(${gain}*.55)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).shape(.18), s("lt ~ lt ~ ~ lt ~ lt ~ ~ lt ~").speed(.8).gain(${gain}*.6).lpf(700).shape(.3).pan(.5)).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).room(${room}).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
